business.name: BuyerMoment
business.description: Commercial-context intelligence and experimentation software for AI advertising.

products.name: ContextFit Scorer
products.description: Provider-neutral scoring of commerciality, product fit, constraints, location fit, purchase stage, and ad relevance.

evidence.text: The repository implements a deterministic ContextFit scorer with budget, feature, location, stage, and ad-relevance reasoning codes.

products.name: Buyer Moment Discovery
products.description: Evidence-backed discovery and ranking of customer situations that may deserve an advertising experiment.

evidence.text: BuyerMoment generates and ranks evidence-backed Buyer Moments with supporting evidence and confidence.

products.name: TestReadiness and SpendDecision
products.description: Separates commercial potential from readiness to justify a human-approved experiment.

evidence.text: SpendDecision supports TEST, WATCH, ABSTAIN, and BLOCK, with human approval required.

products.name: Business Analyzer
products.description: Turns business, product, and customer evidence into a structured basis for Buyer Moment discovery.

evidence.text: The product architecture includes a Business Analyzer to produce commercial contexts from business evidence.

products.name: Experiment Lab
products.description: Produces structured hypothesis packages, context hints, creative candidates, measurement plans, and export artifacts.

evidence.text: The MVP includes a ChatGPT Ads hypothesis package generator and JSON export; it does not claim a live platform integration.

products.name: Benchmark and Evidence Lab
products.description: Maintains CCB-1 benchmark assets, hidden evaluation, failure taxonomies, and calibration evidence.

evidence.text: The repository contains CCB-1 real-data normalization, hidden splits, calibration reports, and failure taxonomy artifacts.

offers.name: B2B SaaS BuyerMoment analysis
offers.description: A structured evidence review that produces ranked Buyer Moments and human-approved experiment hypotheses for a B2B SaaS advertiser.
offers.eligibility: B2B SaaS design partners during commercial validation.

evidence.text: The Phase 7 strategy selects B2B SaaS advertisers and agencies as the initial design-partner audience.
BuyerMoment is positioned as commercial-context intelligence for AI advertising, not a generic copywriter, ad network, or autonomous media buyer.
Human approval remains mandatory and live advertising is not launched by the current product.
The repository has no real advertiser interviews, accepted external experiments, live campaigns, or campaign outcomes recorded yet.

target_customer_hypotheses.label: SaaS marketer translating customer situations into AI-ad context
target_customer_hypotheses.situation: A B2B SaaS marketer is deciding which customer situations are specific enough to test in an AI advertising channel.
target_customer_hypotheses.problem: The team has product and customer evidence but lacks a disciplined way to rank which commercial contexts deserve an experiment.
target_customer_hypotheses.desired_outcome: Prioritize a small set of evidence-backed contexts and turn them into reviewable experiment hypotheses.

target_customer_hypotheses.label: Agency packaging AI-ad strategy for a SaaS client
target_customer_hypotheses.situation: An agency is preparing an AI-ad strategy for a B2B SaaS client and needs a traceable path from evidence to experiment.
target_customer_hypotheses.problem: A client-facing recommendation can become generic copy unless the customer situation, product fit, and uncertainty remain visible.
target_customer_hypotheses.desired_outcome: Deliver a defensible opportunity report and an exportable experiment package without claiming performance.

target_customer_hypotheses.label: Growth team exploring intent beyond search keywords
target_customer_hypotheses.situation: A B2B SaaS growth team is exploring conversational advertising beyond conventional keyword campaigns.
target_customer_hypotheses.problem: The team needs a platform-neutral way to describe context, product fit, constraints, and downstream business outcomes.
target_customer_hypotheses.desired_outcome: Compare context-led hypotheses against later campaign outcomes without reading private conversations.

target_customer_hypotheses.label: Marketer converting customer research into a test
target_customer_hypotheses.situation: A marketer has website, product, and customer evidence and wants to know which situation is actionable now.
target_customer_hypotheses.problem: Commercial potential, immediate test readiness, and unsupported inference can be conflated.
target_customer_hypotheses.desired_outcome: See evidence, inference, risks, and human approval requirements before creating a small test.

target_customer_hypotheses.label: Advertiser linking context hypotheses to outcomes
target_customer_hypotheses.situation: An advertiser wants to learn whether commercial-context quality predicts useful experiment outcomes.
target_customer_hypotheses.problem: A campaign result is hard to interpret if the original Buyer Moment, score, offer, and experiment version are not preserved.
target_customer_hypotheses.desired_outcome: Keep an immutable lineage from Buyer Moment to experiment to manually imported outcome.

unknowns: whether advertisers can control context-hint experiments sufficiently
